summary: NuGet distinguishes a signed package content hash from the raw archive hash. The immutable PackageArchiveReader source first obtains signed-package content identity and uses a whole-archive SHA512 fallback for unsigned packages; GetArchiveHash separately hashes the complete archive stream. A packages.lock.json contentHash must therefore not be compared as if it were an independently observed signed nupkg archive SHA512. Preserve both observations and their exact source/package/archive correspondence; normal dependency/security and executed artifact gates remain independent. The selected Coordination BouncyCastle lock records content identity only; no archive signature verification, installed provenance or native acceptance is established by a lock byte. Original archived decision observations are not rewritten as a different hash kind.
title: Compare NuGet signed-package content and archive hashes by identity
